sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
POLIFILM is a second generation family-run global leader in the manufacture of extrusion and protection films with recycling expertise, operating with 13 production companies in 7 countries.

Industry: Plastics & Films · Size: $250M-$1B · Products: PE & PP films, Laminating films, Label films, Stretch films, Protection films, Performance films

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: POLIFILM scores 43 of 100 (tier C) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (16/30), company size (12/15) and pain-point alignment (15/15). Nothing was found for application fit and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, weatherability, chemical resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (64% similar on films, protection, performance, film); Drytac (48% similar on films, laminating, protective, film); ORAFOL Europe (45% similar on films, self-adhesive, performance, discover). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.
